verdict.rationale: Hightouch's docs list official SDKs for browser, iOS, Android, Node.js and other platforms, each with its own docs page, plus an HTTP Tracking API with a batch endpoint. Separately, a bearer-token REST API covers syncs, models, sources and destinations. The SDKs, however, appear to cover only Events data collection; the management side is exposed as a raw REST API with no evidenced client SDK, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths. Missing for 10: official SDKs for the management/REST API, a published OpenAPI spec, SDK depth details (versions, language coverage beyond the named platforms), independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
